The "Intelligent + Education" initiative aims to coordinate the balanced layout and coordinated development among regions, schools, and groups, achieving a scientific plan for the construction of artificial intelligence education curricula, teacher training, and talent cultivation, with a step-by-step approach and collaborative development.

(22) Strengthen safety and controllability. Adhere to a prudent and inclusive approach, in accordance with laws and regulations, to cultivate students' awareness of data security and privacy protection, and to learn how to properly handle the relationship between people, technology, and society. Follow the objective development laws of artificial intelligence education to prevent risks such as excessive dependence on technology and cognitive dullness among teachers and students. When selecting artificial intelligence products or services, ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations regarding data usage and intellectual property protection. Strengthen the assessment of potential rule conflicts, social risks, and ethical challenges brought about by artificial intelligence technology, and continuously enhance the compliance and appropriateness of artificial intelligence applications in the education sector.
